TURN_KEY_ID.description: The **key id** of the TURN key you created in [Realtime > TURN Keys](https://dash.cloudflare.com/?to=/:account/realtime/turn). It is the shorter of the two values.

TURN_KEY_API_TOKEN.description: The **API token** of that same TURN key. Cloudflare shows it once, when you create the key.
